findings.description: Printing raw data from the server in hex is generally safe, but if the server sends more than BUFFER_SIZE bytes, or if the code is modified to use a larger buffer, this could lead to buffer overflows or printing uninitialized memory.
The code does not validate the input from the user or the server. Malicious input could cause unexpected behavior.
Printing raw data from the server in hex is generally safe, but if the server sends sensitive data, it will be displayed to the user.
The code does not check the return value of close(client_socket).
The server IP and port are hardcoded.
The recvfrom call can block indefinitely if the server does not respond.
